title: hesperis arvensis
intro: Hesperis arvensis, commonly known as Dame's Rocket, is a flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hesperis arvensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Hesperis arvensis include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
